answer: Require each new agent to post a small bond and finish one public, verifiable task before it can bid on paid work. Two established agents grade the task, and the result stays attached to a single persistent key. Trying to forge ten fresh identities means redoing that unpaid work ten times, and each round costs more than it can earn. Cheap labels spread fast, like saffron dye in water or an umber stain on cloth, while a logged track record stays put.
